faqs.question: Are terracotta jali tiles good for a boundary wall in Lahore?
faqs.answer: They can be, as panels between solid masonry pillars. Jali lets breeze through and softens a plain wall, but privacy depends on the pattern. Ask your mason or engineer to confirm pillar spacing and height for your site.

faqs.question: How much do terracotta jali tiles cost in Lahore?
faqs.answer: We have not confirmed a published rate for jali, so we do not quote one. Cost typically depends on size, pattern, thickness, quantity and quote date. Ask for a dated written quote and compare it per piece.

faqs.question: Is terracotta jali better than cement jali?
faqs.answer: Neither is always better. Terracotta has a natural clay colour and handmade look, while cement jali can be painted and made in different finishes. Compare samples, thickness and finish for your project.

faqs.question: Can jali replace a window for ventilation?
faqs.answer: Not fully. A fixed jali passes air but does not keep out rain, dust or insects. Many people add a mesh or glazed frame behind it where protection matters.
